hooks.command: python3 -c "import os, subprocess, sys; d = os.path.expanduser('~/.claude'); sys.exit(subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'pull', '--ff-only']).returncode if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(d, '.git')) else 0)"

python3 -c 'import sys, json, os; d = json.load(sys.stdin); f = d.get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""); ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1]; code_exts = {".ts", ".js", ".tsx", ".jsx", ".py", ".go", ".rs", ".java", ".c", ".cpp", ".h"}; ts_note = " (2) typescript skill rules (type safety, no any, explicit return types)." if ext in {".ts", ".tsx"} else ""; print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "[CODE-STYLE REMINDER] Editing " + ext + " file. Verify: (1) code-style skill rules. (2) typescript skill if .ts." + " (3) Verify-then-write: check how consumers parse the data you produce. Read skill files if not yet loaded."}})) if ext in code_exts else None'

python3 -c 'import sys, json, os; d = json.load(sys.stdin); f = d.get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""); b = os.path.basename(f); print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "additionalContext": "[PLAN CODE REMINDER] Plan sample code must follow code-style and typescript skill rules identically to implementation code. Open both skill files and verify rule-by-rule before writing diff blocks. Common violations to check: Type/Interface section blank lines, check vs is naming, Initial State pattern, named export (vs `export =`), nullish truthy preference, inline type extraction."}})) if "claude-plans" in f and b.startswith("plan-") and b.endswith(".md") else None'
